messages:
maya (PM): Heads-up: Support ticket S-4123 from Sokara — they need low-latency streaming of chat with incremental fncall frames to their on-prem webhook. Must support partial JSON frames, resume on reconnect, and ordering guarantees. Can we triage?

sam (Support): Customer says current behavior drops partial fncall outputs after failover. Wants resumable offsets, webhook acks, and retriable delivery.

ravi (Sales): Sokara is on Dedicated trial; they may sign a 3yr commit if we deliver. Need demo for their compliance team. Prioritize? :eyes: 

lina (Eng): Scope check: define frame envelope, resume semantics (cursor/idempotency), and delivery model (at-least-once vs dedup).

adrian (Platform): For on-prem webhook we should offer mTLS + signed JWT now; HSM/KMS later. Also configurable retry/backoff and rate-limit protection.

maya (PM): Sam, paste example payloads from the ticket. Ravi, loop in legal/compliance.

sam (Support): Customer example:
{ "frame_type":"fncall_patch", "call_id":"c-789", "cursor":102, "payload": {"args_partial":"{\"email\":\"ops@...\"}"}}
{ "frame_type":"fncall_end", "call_id":"c-789", "status":"ok", "result": {"user_id":1234}}
They want a small header per chunk and an ack token response to advance cursor.

lina (Eng): Proposal: structured JSON frames with seq + cursor. Client must ack with {ack_cursor:<n>} for progress. On reconnect use last ack to resume. SDKs will handle reassembly.

maya (PM): Launch criteria (MVP): API contract reviewed, end-to-end demo with Sokara, resume tests, duplicate suppression, perf SLO: p95 <150ms added latency.

lina (Eng): Ballpark: 3-6 wks for core streaming + resume, +2wks SDKs, +1wk security review. HSM adds 3-4wks.

ravi (Sales): I'll draft pilot letter for 6wk pilot contingent on demo. Legal flagged for audit docs.

sam (Support): Added ticket to backlog and posted sample webhook handler pseudocode.

maya (PM): Decision: move to backlog as P1 for Dedicated trial customers. Label=enterprise-streaming-webhook, milestone=Q2-stretch. Owners to follow up.
